topic: Premultiplied associated alpha vs straight unassociated alpha under bilinear filtering
topic_zh: 预乘关联 Alpha 与直通非关联 Alpha 双线性边缘过滤对比
scope: Deterministic Porter-Duff OVER compositing under bilinear texture filtering across a 17-tap silhouette edge: Premultiplied Associated Alpha (C_tilde = alpha*C) versus Straight Unassociated Alpha color bleeding. No neural video matting execution.

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. Division-free premultiplied Porter-Duff OVER evaluation versus per-sample alpha division unpremultiplication and re-blending.

protocol.function: I_out(t) = lerp(α_A·C_A, α_B·C_B, t) + (1 − lerp(α_A, α_B, t))·B_sky → 0.00% dark halo dip

robustness.name: Sampled bilinear silhouette taps preserve monotonic edge radiance

good_fit: Bilinearly filtered sprites, mipmapped foliage/decals, particle smoke, and alpha-matted video overlays
Explaining why Straight Alpha squares the filter weight into (1-t)^2 and leaks transparent black (0,0,0,0) into edges
Unified single-pass rendering of both standard alpha occlusion (alpha > 0) and additive emissive fire/glow (alpha = 0)
Front-to-back or back-to-front 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) splat accumulation without dark edge halos
not_for: Fully opaque textures (alpha == 1 everywhere) where premultiplied and straight alpha are identical
Color-picker UI inputs where artists edit unassociated RGB hex values independently of opacity slider
Neural trimap-free video matting inference (RVM / MatAnyone) that predicts alpha masks from raw RGB frames
Order-independent transparency (OIT) linked-list depth sorting without pre-sorted primitives
